### 7.4 Proof bundle

Every incident produces `evidence/<INC>/bundle.json` (schema in Appendix E.3) together with:
- trace exports;
- the cassette;
- graph outputs;
- the Intent Record;
- gate reports;
- the SPRT path;
- the cost breakdown;
- the PR and CI URLs;
- the checkpoint IDs.

The bundle's SHA‑256 is written into its ledger entry.

### 7.5 `kintsugi audit`

```
kintsugi audit [--all] [--autonomy] [--incident INC-…] [--sabotage S-…] [--antibody AB-…]
               [--offline <bundle_dir>] [--json]
  online mode : needs read-only GitHub access (public repos) and, optionally, a neatlogs read token
  offline mode: verifies hashes, signatures and internal consistency from published bundles only
exit codes    : 0 all checks pass · 1 at least one check fails · 2 checks skipped (missing access)
```

| Check | What it verifies |
|---|---|
| C1 | The ledger chain is valid from h_0 to head, and every anchor tag matches h_i |
| C2 | Every protected-branch commit in W has `Kintsugi-*` trailers |
| C3 | Every attestation signature verifies against the T0 public key |
| C4 | An Entire checkpoint exists for each commit, and its transcript contains the attested nonce [A2] |
| C5 | The first prompt of each session hashes to `Kintsugi-Prompt` |
| C6 | Every sabotage commitment matches its reveal; ordering holds; honeytoken has zero hits |
| C7 | Each incident's G7 run exists and passed (GitHub Actions API) |
| C8 | The trace IDs in bundles exist (neatlogs `GET /traces/{id}`) and their timestamps fit the incident window |
| C9 | Completeness: every detection hit in W maps to the ledger |
| C10 | Cost actuals equal the sum of neatlogs session costs, within 1% |
| C11 | Each antibody's lineage is consistent (versions, quarantines, evidence links) |
| C12 | The rulesets were active throughout W (GitHub API) |
| C13 | Holdout manifest hashes are unchanged since T0 |
| C14 | Self-repairs touched no protected self-repair paths |

**Sample output** [I]:

```
kintsugi audit --all
C1  ledger chain ......................... 1,284 entries, 24 anchors        PASS
C2  attested commits ..................... 61/61 commits in W               PASS
C3  signatures ........................... 61/61 valid (ecdsa-p256)        PASS
C4  checkpoint linkage ................... 61/61 nonce found in transcript  PASS
C5  prompt provenance .................... 61/61                           PASS
C6  sealed sabotage ...................... 3/3 commitments, 0 honeytoken hits PASS
C7  independent CI ....................... 23/23 runs green                 PASS
C8  trace existence ...................... 412/412                         PASS
C9  completeness ......................... 187 hits → 47 incidents + 140 dedupes PASS
C10 cost reconciliation .................. Δ 0.3%                          PASS
C11 antibody lineage ..................... 6 antibodies, 1 quarantine      PASS
C12 rulesets ............................. active 24h00m                   PASS
C13 holdout integrity .................... 4/4 manifests                   PASS
C14 self-repair scope .................... 1/1                             PASS
HUMAN COMMITS IN WINDOW: 0
```

`make judge` runs `kintsugi audit --all --offline ./published-bundles`. It needs no credentials.

### 7.6 The Repair Clinic: third-party PR strategy

**Why it matters most.** A PR that an **independent maintainer chooses to merge** is the one proof we cannot author ourselves. It also feeds Building in Public and the community prize.

**Intake post** (Discord #neatHack and X):
> *"Free verified-fix PR for your agent. Give us your repo; Omega instruments it, finds a real failure, fixes it and opens a PR with before/after neatlogs traces and an Entire checkpoint. Opt-in only. PR-only. We never merge into your repo."*

**Consent form fields:**
- repo URL, entry point, run command, model provider;
- whether the owner can share neatlogs trace exports (for replay mode);
- checkboxes:
  - ☐ PRs only;
  - ☐ sandboxed execution of my code;
  - ☐ no secrets shared;
  - ☐ results may be published (anonymised if requested).

**Pipeline:** Onboarding O1–O7 (§5.9.4) → incidents and vaccinations → PRs on the owner's repo using the receipt template (Appendix E.4) → tracking.

**What counts:**
- `merged_by` ≠ any Omega or team account (GitHub API);
- time-to-merge;
- whether the maintainer commented.

**Ethics:**
- Unsolicited PRs: never.
- Repos whose owner has not consented: never.
- If an antibody behind an open PR is quarantined, Omega comments on and updates the PR, or closes it with an honest explanation (§6.7).

### 7.7 The Arena (public, judge-triggerable)

| Panel | Content |
|---|---|
| Fleet board | Every host: health, SLO, open incidents, last canary |
| Incident stream | Live state transitions with links to traces, checkpoints and PRs |
| Immunity matrix | A heatmap of hosts × antibodies (protected / vulnerable / n/a) |
| Learning curve | Cost per repair vs cumulative n (log-log) with the fitted b̂ |
| Ledger head | The current h_i and the last anchor |
| **Sabotage it** | A form: choose a host and a fault family, or describe a fault in free text |

**Free-text safety.**
- Free text is compiled by `claude-haiku-5-5` through **tool use with a strict JSON schema** whose fields are catalog enums and bounded numbers. Code is never generated from user text.
- The compiled spec is sealed like any other, and the requester receives the commitment `c` immediately.
- Limits: 1 request per IP per 10 minutes, a daily budget cap enforced by the governor, and a fleet scope restricted to our own hosts.
- Escalations and failures are **shown, not hidden**.

### 7.8 Proof matrix summary

| Claim | Evidence | Verifier independence | Strength |
|---|---|---|---|
| It repairs real failures | Clinic merges; OSS PRs | Third party | ★★★★★ |
| It was blind to the answer | Sealed sabotage + honeytoken | Cryptographic, public | ★★★★★ |
| No human wrote code in W | Attestation + Entire + rulesets + CloudTrail | Cryptographic, platform | ★★★★☆ (limits stated) |
| The fixes work | G4 holdout + G7 CI + canary | Platform (GitHub) + statistics | ★★★★☆ |
| Nothing was cherry-picked | Ledger completeness against neatlogs hits | Cross-system | ★★★★☆ |
| It survives its own failures | Temporal history, S‑18 | Server-side logs | ★★★★☆ |
| It learns and compounds | Antibody lineage; learning curve from actuals | Cross-system (neatlogs costs) | ★★★☆☆ (needs volume) |
| Economically rational | Decision spans + cfo.ai plan vs actual | Internal + cfo.ai | ★★★☆☆ |

## 10. cfo.ai business plan (pricing, costs, revenue, runway)

All figures are [I] until replaced with modeled values from cfo.ai and actuals.

**Pricing:**

| Tier | Price | Includes |
|---|---|---|
| Pilot | $99 per host per month (1 host) | Monitoring, primary + secondary responses within the pool, PR-only mode |
| Team | $299 per host per month | Everything in Pilot, plus auto-merge with canary, vaccination, antibody library access |
| Fleet | Custom | Private library, SSO, dedicated budget policies |
| Outcome fee (scenario) | $15 per prevented incident | Charged only for vaccination-confirmed preventions |

**Cost structure:**
- **COGS:** LLM inference (crew + host evals, metered by the proxy); sandbox compute; storage; the neatlogs, Entire and cfo.ai subscriptions allocated per host.
- **Opex:** team, tools, infrastructure baseline.

**Unit economics.** See §3.5.5. Gross margin rises from 66.5% at 10 hosts to 79.7% at 100 hosts and 86.4% at 1,000 hosts, as antibody coverage q grows.

**Runway scenarios.** Starting cash $150,000. Fixed burn $14,000 per month (2 founders plus tools). Starting fleet: 10 Team hosts. Gross margin follows q(N) from §3.5.

| Scenario | Host growth | Margin assumption | Month 6 (hosts / GM) | Month 12 (hosts / GM) | Breakeven month | Lowest cash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base | +25% per month | q(N) as in §3.5.5 | 31 / 72.9% | 116 / 80.2% | **10** | $80.6k |
| Growth | +40% per month | q(N) | 54 / 76.2% | 405 / 83.8% | **7** | $101.7k |
| Network | +25% per month | q + 0.10, vaccination prevents 15% of incidents | 31 / 78.9% | 116 / 85.1% | **9** | $84.6k |

**Runway definition:** months until cash < 0 at the current net burn (fixed costs − gross profit). In all three scenarios cash stays positive and the business breaks even inside 12 months. **Plan vs actual:** every night, measured C_ι, μ, q, v and b̂ replace the assumptions (§4.6.5).

# KINTSUGI-Ω gap audit (read-only, HEAD `74ce382`)

The biggest finding is not in any of the docs: **an Arena request would crash the sabotage campaign during the window.** Arena faults can't be delivered yet, and the delivery failure is not caught, so the campaign workflow stops before S-17/18/19 go out. Opening the Arena in W is blocked until that's handled.

**How I checked:**
- **Files read:** `MASTER_HANDOFF.md`, `docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md`, `docs/VERIFICATION.md`, and the code that matters.
- **Blueprint:** I read `Blueprint_Omega_Master.md` in part, as you asked: the outline plus §4.2, §4.6, §5.1–5.3, §5.9.4, §6.9–6.11, §7.4–7.8 and §8–§12. I did not read all 2,347 lines.
- **Not found:** `STAGE_8_13_HANDOFF.md` is not in the tree.
- **Audit rules:** I used only file reads and searches. No shell, git, tests or edits; "HEAD `74ce382`" is from the end of the last run, not a fresh check.

## 1. Fully implemented (offline-verified, pushed)

| Stage | Verdict |
|---|---|
| 1–7 (foundation, Entire layer, fleet, senses, control plane, crew and gates, antibodies) | **Complete for the offline scope.** Baselines run on the offline model stand-in (disclosed in A-23). |
| 8 (proof plane) | **Nearly complete.** Audit C1–C14 with its mutation suite, the ledger branch and anchors, and the Saboteur are done. The per-incident proof bundles of blueprint §7.4 (`evidence/<INC>/bundle.json`) are not built; this is disclosed in MASTER_HANDOFF §5. |
| 9 (economic cortex) | **Complete offline.** What's missing is live-only and disclosed. |
| 12 (self-repair) | **Machinery complete.** The replay suite has 4 of the planned 20 incidents (disclosed in A-71). |
| 13a (W runtime wiring) | **Complete offline.** |
| 10 (onboarding), 11 (Arena) | **Not complete.** See section 3. |
| 13b, W, Stage 14 | **Not started**, by design. |

## 2. Intentionally deferred, and correctly disclosed

- **Window and T0:** the window W, T0, the 13b dress rehearsal and Stage 14. The T0 key, holdout re-seal, genesis, rulesets on `main` and anchor posts are Architect-held.
- **Sealed sabotage:** composing and sealing S-17/18/19 (A-57, A-69).
- **Runtime:** the Temporal CLI in WSL; the dead-man Lambda (A-46).
- **neatlogs (needs this edition's project and `.env`):** live C10 cost check, re-provisioning receptors, a stable ingress URL. Also the silent alert rules (A-38), the 3–4% trace loss (A-39) and the OAuth-only operations (A-29). The Fixes MCP is not configured.
- **Live models and cfo.ai:** cfo.ai's Ari MCP (A-70); live model baselines (A-23; Bedrock is not authorised); the model-tier spikes, which need a logged-in headless CLI.
- **Arena:** the Haiku realism rubric (A-68); the model-assisted Arena compiler and chaos-proxy deliveries (A-72, A-75).
- **Your inputs:** OSS-1 on a real repository and every foreign post (A-74); the real cash and fixed costs (A-73 placeholders).
- **History:** the `files_touched` gaps (A-37, A-58) and the orphan checkpoint are recorded.

## 3. The gap: undisclosed or under-disclosed debt

**Will break things in W**

1. **An Arena request crashes the sabotage campaign.**
   - Arena faults are environment classes, which have no patch. `do_deliver_sabotage` raises `NotImplementedError` for them (`factory.py:478`).
   - `deliver_sabotage` gets 3 attempts (`activities.py:195`). `SabotageCampaign.run` does not catch the failure (`workflows.py:486-501`), so the whole workflow fails.
   - An Arena request is scheduled about 5 minutes after arrival, ahead of the later S-17/18/19 deliveries. One public request would therefore stop the real sabotage schedule.
   - The docs only say delivery "waits on wiring", which understates this.
2. **The Onboarding workflow has no real implementation.** `OmegaCrew` has 37 handlers for 38 activities; `onboard_step` is the missing one (`factory.py:177` raises). It passes only with the scripted test crew. The OSS-1 rehearsal called `pipeline.onboard` directly, never the workflow, yet Stage 10's build list names "the Onboarding workflow".

**Onboarding deviates from blueprint §5.9.4, with no amendment saying so**

3. A-72 describes what was built but never records it as a deviation:
   - **Sandboxing:** O2 is not a sandbox clone with dependency install.
   - **Instrumentation:** O3 is a static scan, not headless instrumentation plus `neatlogs doctor`.
   - **Entire setup:** there is no O4 `entire enable`/index step.
   - **Eval synthesis:** O5 builds seed evals from failing traces only, with no train/holdout split or manifest hash.
   - **Replay:** replay mode builds no cassettes from `/traces/{id}/export`.
   - **Where the host ran:** the rehearsal ran the host as a local subprocess, not under gVisor.
4. **The health card misses the practice host's tools.** The OSS-1 evidence shows `tools: []` and `side_effecting_http: []`, though the host has three `@span(kind="TOOL")` tools, including the side-effecting `create_contact`. The scanner doesn't see neatlogs decorators or HTTP calls made through `hostkit.external`. This was recorded but not flagged.
5. **A passing trace becomes a failure seed.** `eval_synth` treats any failed span as a failure, even when the task passed after a retry. Example: `seed-03fb98ae3653`, expected failure "enrich", no task id. That is why O3 counts 22 failures against 21 FAIL verdicts.

**Arena differs from blueprint §7.7**

6. Missing from the board:
   - Open incidents and last canary on the fleet board.
   - A "vulnerable" state in the immunity matrix.
   - A log-log learning curve (mine is log-y only).
   - The last anchor beside the ledger head.
   - Links in the incident stream.

   The daily cap is a request count, not a dollar cap enforced by the governor.
7. **Id-reuse edge case.** Spec ids are numbered from a local SQLite counter. If `.state/arena` is reset while the sealed store persists, numbering restarts and `Saboteur.seal` returns an old commitment for a new request.

**Economics (§10)**

8. The A-73 placeholders ($250k cash, $18k/month) don't match the blueprint's own illustrative figures ($150k, $14k/month, 10 Team hosts). The runway is a single point; the blueprint's Base/Growth/Network growth scenarios, breakeven month and lowest-cash figures are not modelled (`scenarios.csv` only varies antibody coverage q).

**Missing pieces and stale text**

9. **Demo stub:** `kintsugi demo` (and `make demo`) exits 2 with "not built yet", and the Stage 13 demo is not on any remaining-work list. `_PENDING["fleet"]` in `cli.py` is dead code.
10. **Unused neatlogs write-back (§4.2):** `traces.feedback` has a client method but no caller. Span feedback, comment messages and `evaluators.run` are pinned in the API contract but never called.
11. **Other blueprint items not built and not disclosed:** `.github/workflows/audit.yml` (§12) and the Textual operator TUI (§11).
12. **Stale docs:**
    - The `factory.py` docstring (lines 9–14) still says the ledger is a file until Stage 8, and that Stage 7 "nothing exists yet".
    - MASTER_HANDOFF's overnight "Waiting on the Architect" list still names the Arena board.
13. **Test gaps:**
    - `arena_state` / `load_ledger` with a real ledger branch and window record (my test monkeypatched the ledger).
    - The Onboarding workflow with the real crew.
    - Trace export always writes cost and token counts of 0.

Items 1 and 2 are the ones I would fix before 13b. I'm waiting for your next command.

"""Chaos-proxy delivery of environment sabotage (Appendix B ``env.*``, §7.2, §7.7).

Patch classes are delivered as an upstream change through a notary session; the five
environment classes are delivered here instead, as **overlay rules** for the chaos proxy that
already sits in front of every host's external services:

- ``ChaosOverlay.deliver(spec)`` compiles an opened spec into chaos rules on the target tool's
  external service and writes ``<folder>/<spec id>.json`` atomically, active from now until
  ``schedule.duration_s`` later. The folder lives under the runtime's state directory, outside
  the repository; the fleet's chaos proxy reads it on every call (``ChaosProxy(overlay=…)``).
- Overlay draws are keyed by the sabotage id, never by a rule index, so adding or expiring an
  overlay never shifts the background profile's seeded faults (A-24).

The mapping from catalog parameters to faults:

| class | fault | parameters |
|---|---|---|
| ``env.rate_limit`` | ``status`` 429 | ``rate``; a firing call starts a run of ``burst`` failing calls |
| ``env.latency`` | ``latency`` | log-normal delay through ``p50_ms`` and ``p95_ms`` |
| ``env.schema_drift`` | ``schema_drift`` | ``change``: rename_field, drop_field or type_change |
| ``env.partial_response`` | ``partial`` | keeps ``100 − truncation_pct`` percent of a list or text |
| ``env.pagination_change`` | ``pagination`` | pages of ``page_size`` with a ``cursor_format`` cursor |
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import threading
from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.sandbox.chaos_proxy import Rule

DEFAULT_DURATION_S = 1800.0  # an environment fault lasts 30 minutes unless the spec says so
OVERLAY_DIR = Path("chaos") / "active"  # under the runtime's state directory


class OverlayError(ValueError):
    pass


def compile_env(spec: Mapping[str, Any], external: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, str]]
                ) -> list[Rule]:  # fmt: skip
    """``external``: host → tool → the external service its calls go through."""
    cls = str(spec.get("class", ""))
    target = dict(spec.get("target") or {})
    host, tool = str(target.get("host", "")), str(target.get("tool", ""))
    service = (external.get(host) or {}).get(tool)
    if service is None:
        raise OverlayError(f"{tool!r} is not an external tool of {host!r}")
    sid = str(spec.get("id"))
    tag = {"sabotage": sid}
    if cls == "env.rate_limit":
        return [Rule(service, "status", float(target["rate"]), "*",
                     {**tag, "status": 429, "burst": int(target["burst"])})]  # fmt: skip
    if cls == "env.latency":
        return [Rule(service, "latency", 1.0, "*",
                     {**tag, "p50_ms": int(target["p50_ms"]),
                      "p95_ms": int(target["p95_ms"])})]  # fmt: skip
    if cls == "env.schema_drift":
        return [Rule(service, "schema_drift", 1.0, "*", {**tag, "change": str(target["change"])})]
    if cls == "env.partial_response":
        keep = 1.0 - int(target["truncation_pct"]) / 100.0
        return [Rule(service, "partial", 1.0, "*", {**tag, "keep": keep})]
    if cls == "env.pagination_change":
        return [Rule(service, "pagination", 1.0, "*",
                     {**tag, "page_size": int(target["page_size"]),

"""The fabric a host runs behind: the LLM metering proxy and the seeded chaos proxy.

``with Fabric(hosts, FabricConfig(seed=2)) as fabric:`` starts both proxies on ephemeral ports
and ``fabric.env(host)`` gives a host process exactly what it needs to reach them, and nothing
secret: a ``kintsugi-proxy-`` token for the LLM proxy and the chaos proxy's URL. The model
upstream is the Anthropic API when a key is configured, otherwise each host's labelled offline
stand-in (amendment A-23). Spend is metered per host in the shared SQLite ledger.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
import secrets
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from types import TracebackType
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.sandbox import chaos_proxy as chaos
from kintsugi.sandbox import llm_proxy as lp
from kintsugi.sandbox.cassette import Player, Recorder
from kintsugi.sandbox.httpserve import Handler, HttpRequest, HttpResponse, Server
from kintsugi.sandbox.runner import PROXY_PLACEHOLDER

from .hosts import HostSpec, resolve

DAILY_CAP_USD = 20.0  # amendment A-23 (ruling D7)


def load_dotenv(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """``KEY=VALUE`` lines of a ``.env`` file (values are never printed)."""
    values: dict[str, str] = {}
    if not path.is_file():
        return values
    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
        values[key.strip()] = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    return values


ServiceFn = Callable[..., tuple[int, Any]]


def service_handler(fn: ServiceFn) -> Handler:
    """Adapt a host's mock service ``(method, path, query, body[, namespace]) -> (status,
    json)``. A service that takes ``namespace`` gets the calling task's id, so stateful mocks
    (Triage's GitHub) keep each task's side effects apart."""
    namespaced = "namespace" in inspect.signature(fn).parameters

    def handle(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
        args = (request.method, request.path, request.query, request.body)
        status, body = fn(*args, namespace=request.task) if namespaced else fn(*args)
        return HttpResponse.of_json(status, body)

    return handle


@dataclass
class FabricConfig:
    seed: int
    profile: chaos.Profile = field(default_factory=chaos.background_profile)
    daily_cap_usd: float = DAILY_CAP_USD
    spend_path: Path | str = ":memory:"
    anthropic_key: str | None = None
    bind: str = "127.0.0.1"
    chaos_recorder: Recorder | None = None
    llm_recorder: Recorder | None = None
    player: Player | None = None  # replay a cassette: tool and model I/O, faults included
    live_services: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # the host's own state: never recorded or replayed


class Fabric:
    def __init__(self, hosts: Mapping[str, HostSpec], config: FabricConfig) -> None:
        self.hosts = dict(hosts)
        self.config = config
        self.tokens = {h: f"{PROXY_PLACEHOLDER}{h}-{secrets.token_hex(8)}" for h in self.hosts}
        upstream: lp.Upstream
        if config.player is not None:
            upstream = lp.CassetteUpstream(config.player)
        elif config.anthropic_key:
            upstream = lp.AnthropicUpstream(config.anthropic_key)
        else:
            upstream = lp.OfflineUpstream(
                {h: resolve(spec.offline_model) for h, spec in self.hosts.items()}
            )
        self.upstream = upstream
        limits = {lp.account_of(h): lp.AccountLimits(spec.economics.llm_budget_usd_month)
                  for h, spec in self.hosts.items()}  # fmt: skip
        self.spend = lp.SpendLedger(config.spend_path, daily_cap_usd=config.daily_cap_usd,
                                    limits=limits)  # fmt: skip
        services: dict[str, chaos.Upstream] = {}
        self._resets: list[Callable[[], None]] = []
        for spec in self.hosts.values():
            for name, dotted in spec.services.items():
                if name in services:
                    raise ValueError(f"service {name!r} is declared by two hosts")
                fn = resolve(dotted)
                services[name] = service_handler(fn)
                reset: Callable[[], None] | None = getattr(inspect.getmodule(fn), "reset", None)
                if reset is not None:  # stateful mocks start empty for every fabric
                    self._resets.append(reset)
        profile = config.profile.with_seed(config.seed)
        self.chaos = chaos.ChaosProxy(
            services, profile, recorder=config.chaos_recorder, player=config.player,
            live=frozenset(config.live_services),
        )  # fmt: skip
        self.llm = lp.LlmProxy(upstream, self.spend, self.tokens, recorder=config.llm_recorder)
        self._servers = [Server(self.llm, host=config.bind), Server(self.chaos, host=config.bind)]

    @property
    def model_mode(self) -> str:
        return self.upstream.name

    def env(self, host: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        llm_server, chaos_server = self._servers
        return {
            "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": f"{llm_server.url}/h/{host}",
            "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": self.tokens[host],

and ``fabric.env(host)`` gives a host process exactly what it needs to reach them, and nothing
secret: a ``kintsugi-proxy-`` token for the LLM proxy and the chaos proxy's URL. The model

import secrets
from collections import Counter

    values: dict[str, str] = {}
    if not path.is_file():

    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()

        key, _, value = line.partition("=")

ServiceFn = Callable[..., tuple[int, Any]]


def service_handler(fn: ServiceFn) -> Handler:
    """Adapt a host's mock service ``(method, path, query, body[, namespace]) -> (status,

    (Triage's GitHub) keep each task's side effects apart."""
    namespaced = "namespace" in inspect.signature(fn).parameters

    def handle(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
        args = (request.method, request.path, request.query, request.body)
        status, body = fn(*args, namespace=request.task) if namespaced else fn(*args)

    player: Player | None = None  # replay a cassette: tool and model I/O, faults included
    live_services: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # the host's own state: never recorded or replayed
    overlay: ChaosOverlay | None = None  # environment sabotage delivered at run time

        elif config.anthropic_key:

        else:

            )

                  for h, spec in self.hosts.items()}  # fmt: skip
        self.spend = lp.SpendLedger(config.spend_path, daily_cap_usd=config.daily_cap_usd,

                if reset is not None:  # stateful mocks start empty for every fabric

        self.chaos = chaos.ChaosProxy(
            services, profile, recorder=config.chaos_recorder, player=config.player,
            live=frozenset(config.live_services),
        )  # fmt: skip
        self.llm = lp.LlmProxy(upstream, self.spend, self.tokens, recorder=config.llm_recorder)
        self._servers = [Server(self.llm, host=config.bind), Server(self.chaos, host=config.bind)]

    def model_mode(self) -> str:
        return self.upstream.name

    def env(self, host: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        llm_server, chaos_server = self._servers

            "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": f"{llm_server.url}/h/{host}",
            "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": self.tokens[host],
            "KINTSUGI_EXT_URL": chaos_server.url,
            "KINTSUGI_HOST": host,
            "KINTSUGI_SEED": str(self.config.seed),

    def chaos_counts(self) -> Counter[str]:
        """Calls and injected faults per service, e.g. ``fx:calls``, ``fx:status#0``."""
        counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
        for row in self.chaos.log:
            counts[f"{row['service']}:calls"] += 1

    def __exit__(
        self,
        exc_type: type[BaseException] | None,
        exc: BaseException | None,
        tb: TracebackType | None,
    ) -> None:
        for server in self._servers:
            server.stop()
        self.chaos.close()

``kintsugi fleet up`` keeps a detached **deploy worktree** of main under ``.state/deploy`` and

    return proc.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], timeout_s=120, check=True).stdout.strip()


@dataclass
class Deployer:

    def sync(self) -> str | None:

"""O4 and O5: seed evals and the baseline from exported traces (Stage 10).

``synthesize`` turns each failing trace into a seed eval case: the input the agent saw, the
failure class it produced (the grader's verdict, or the failing tool's error), and the trace
it came from. The cases are proposals for the maintainers' eval suite, never a holdout.
``baseline`` is the pass rate of the exported traces with its 95% Wilson interval.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.senses.records import TraceRecord
from kintsugi.stats.wilson import wilson_interval


def synthesize(records: Sequence[TraceRecord]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    cases = []
    for record in records:
        failing = [v for v in record.verdicts if not v.passed]
        broken = next((s for s in record.spans if s.failed), None)
        if not failing and broken is None and not record.failed:
            continue
        root = next((s for s in record.spans if s.parent_id is None), None)
        expected = failing[0].verdict if failing else (broken.name if broken else record.status)
        cases.append({
            "id": f"seed-{record.trace_id[:12]}",
            "source_trace": record.trace_id,
            "input_preview": str(root.input if root is not None else "")[:2000],
            "expected_failure": str(expected)[:200],
            "task_id": failing[0].task_id if failing else None,
        })  # fmt: skip
    return cases


def baseline(records: Sequence[TraceRecord]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    n = len(records)
    passed = sum(1 for r in records
                 if not r.failed and all(v.passed for v in r.verdicts))  # fmt: skip
    low, high = wilson_interval(passed, n) if n else (0.0, 0.0)
    return {"traces": n, "passed": passed, "pass_rate": round(passed / n, 4) if n else 0.0,
            "wilson_95": [round(low, 4), round(high, 4)]}  # fmt: skip

"""Onboarding O1–O7 in order, in-process (Stage 10): the same desk the ``Onboarding`` workflow's
``onboard_step`` activities run (``kintsugi.onboard.desk``), for callers without a Temporal
server. One record, every step's result, keyed ``O<n>_<name>``."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import tempfile
from collections.abc import Iterable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control.ship import ShipConfig
from kintsugi.memory.library import AntibodyLibrary
from kintsugi.onboard import intake
from kintsugi.onboard.desk import NAMES, STEPS, OnboardingCase, OnboardingDesk


def ship_config(accepted: intake.Intake) -> ShipConfig:
    """O7: a foreign repository is pull-requests-only; Omega never merges there."""
    return ShipConfig(accepted.repo, pr_only=accepted.pr_only)


def host_id(form_body: str) -> str:
    """The onboarded host's id: the repository's name, made safe for a case folder."""
    repo = intake.parse(form_body).repo
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "-", repo.split("/")[-1])[:64] or "host"


def onboard(
    form_body: str,
    checkout: Path,
    exports: Path | None,
    library: AntibodyLibrary,
    *,
    package_dir: str = ".",
    side_effect_tools: Iterable[str] = (),
    root: Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run O1–O7; an intake without every consent is refused before anything else runs."""
    host = host_id(form_body)  # O1's parse: raises IntakeRefused
    desk = OnboardingDesk(Path(root or tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="kintsugi-onboard-")), library)
    desk.register(OnboardingCase(host, form_body, str(checkout), str(exports) if exports else None,
                                 package_dir, tuple(side_effect_tools)))  # fmt: skip
    record: dict[str, Any] = {"host": host}
    for step in STEPS:
        result = desk.step(host, step)
        record[f"{step}_{NAMES[step]}"] = {"ok": result.ok, **result.detail}
        if not result.ok:
            break
    return record

"""Onboarding O1–O7 in order, offline (Stage 10): intake → health card → replay → evals →
baseline → immune scan → the receipt's shipping terms. One record, every step's result."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control.ship import ShipConfig
from kintsugi.memory.library import AntibodyLibrary
from kintsugi.onboard import eval_synth, immune_scan, instrument, intake, replay_mode


def ship_config(accepted: intake.Intake) -> ShipConfig:
    """O7: a foreign repository is pull-requests-only; Omega never merges there."""
    return ShipConfig(accepted.repo, pr_only=accepted.pr_only)


def onboard(
    form_body: str,
    checkout: Path,
    exports: Path | None,
    library: AntibodyLibrary,
    *,
    package_dir: str = ".",
    side_effect_tools: Iterable[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    accepted = intake.parse(form_body)  # O1: refuses without every consent
    card = instrument.scan(checkout)  # O2
    records = replay_mode.ExportedTraces(exports).records() if exports else []  # O3
    host = accepted.repo.split("/")[-1]
    shipping = ship_config(accepted)
    return {
        "O1_intake": {"repo": accepted.repo, "entry_point": accepted.entry_point,
                      "foreign": accepted.foreign, "consents": len(accepted.consents)},
        "O2_health_card": card.as_dict(),
        "O3_replay": {"traces": len(records),
                      "failures": len(replay_mode.observations(records, host))},
        "O4_evals": eval_synth.synthesize(records),
        "O5_baseline": eval_synth.baseline(records),
        "O6_immune_scan": immune_scan.scan(checkout, library, package_dir=package_dir,
                                           side_effect_tools=side_effect_tools),
        "O7_receipt": {"pr_only": shipping.pr_only, "merge": not shipping.pr_only,
                       "foreign_posts": "each one waits for the Architect's approval"},
    }  # fmt: skip

def run(cfg: OnboardRehearsal) -> dict[str, Any]:
    started = time.monotonic()

        exports = cfg.root / "exports"
        exported = export_traces(checkout, exports, seed=cfg.seed, limit=cfg.limit)
        cfg.log(f"[{cfg.run}] exported {exported['traces']} traces: {exported['verdicts']}")
        library = AntibodyLibrary(OMEGA / "antibodies")
        record = pipeline.onboard(INTAKE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), checkout, exports,
                                  library, package_dir="practice_crm",
                                  side_effect_tools=SIDE_EFFECT_TOOLS)  # fmt: skip
    refused = list(guard.refused) + list(exported["host_non_loopback_refused"])
    cfg.log(f"[{cfg.run}] onboarded: replay {record['O3_replay']}, "
            f"immune scan {record['O6_immune_scan']['status']}")  # fmt: skip
    return {
        "kind": "onboarding-rehearsal", "run": cfg.run, "phase": "rehearsal",
        "oss": "OSS-1 (rehearsal stand-in: the disclosed CRM practice host)",
        "model": "offline (A-23)",
        "disclosed": [
            "OSS-1 is not chosen yet: the checkout is a disposable copy of the disclosed CRM "
            "practice host (A-61), not an open-source repository",
            "the intake names a fictional repository slug that is never contacted",
            "the exported traces are captured locally from the practice host behind a local "
            "fabric (stress profile, offline model): no neatlogs project exists for it",
        ],
        "intake": {"fixture": INTAKE.relative_to(OMEGA).as_posix(), "sha256": _sha(INTAKE)},
        "checkout": {"source": PRACTICE.relative_to(OMEGA).as_posix(),
                     "sha256": _tree_sha(PRACTICE)},
        "exports": {k: v for k, v in exported.items() if k != "host_non_loopback_refused"},
        "onboarding": record,
        "network": {"non_loopback_connections_refused": len(refused), "refused": refused,
                    "foreign_posts": 0, "ports": "none: no GitHub, neatlogs or cfo.ai client "
                                                 "is constructed by the rehearsal"},
        "duration_s": round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
    }  # fmt: skip


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="The OSS-1 onboarding rehearsal (offline).")
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, help="scratch dir outside any repo (default: temp)")
    parser.add_argument("--run", default=datetime.now(UTC).strftime("oss1-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=24)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, help="write the evidence JSON here")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    base = args.root or Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="kintsugi-oss1-"))
    cfg = OnboardRehearsal(args.run, base / args.run, seed=args.seed, limit=args.limit)
    try:
        summary = run(cfg)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(cfg.root, ignore_errors=True)
    text = json.dumps(summary, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
    if args.out:
        args.out.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(text)
    clean = summary["network"]["non_loopback_connections_refused"] == 0
    return 0 if clean and summary["onboarding"]["O7_receipt"]["pr_only"] else 1

"""The OSS-1 onboarding rehearsal (Stage 10, offline, disclosed): O1–O7 on a local practice host.

The Architect has not chosen OSS-1 yet, so the rehearsal onboards the disclosed **CRM practice**
host (``tests/fixtures/rehearsal/crm_practice``, the Clinic stand-in of A-61) end to end, with
nothing leaving this machine:

1. **Checkout**: a disposable copy of the practice host outside every repository (the immune
   scan's graph and verdict cache are written there, never here).
2. **Exported traces**: the practice host runs its train tasks behind a local fabric (seeded
   chaos proxy and offline LLM proxy on 127.0.0.1) under its own disclosed stress profile; its
   spans are captured in memory and written in the neatlogs Public API's export shape
   (``trace_export``). No neatlogs project exists for it, so this stands in for the
   maintainers' export, and says so.
3. **Onboarding**: ``pipeline.onboard`` on the filled-in intake fixture
   (``tests/fixtures/rehearsal/oss1/intake.md``, all five consent boxes checked) with the
   checkout and the exports: intake, health card, replay mode, seed evals, baseline, immune
   scan, PR-only receipt.

The intake names a fictional, disclosed repository slug that is never contacted: the rehearsal
has no GitHub or neatlogs port at all, and a socket guard (in this process and in the host's)
refuses and counts every non-loopback connection. The evidence records both.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.fleet.fabric import Fabric, FabricConfig
from kintsugi.gates.evals import tasks_jsonl
from kintsugi.gates.target import load_target
from kintsugi.memory.library import AntibodyLibrary
from kintsugi.onboard import pipeline, trace_export
from kintsugi.sandbox import proc

OMEGA = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PRACTICE = OMEGA / "tests" / "fixtures" / "rehearsal" / "crm_practice"
INTAKE = OMEGA / "tests" / "fixtures" / "rehearsal" / "oss1" / "intake.md"
HOST = "crm-practice"
SIDE_EFFECT_TOOLS = ("create_contact",)  # host.yaml: the CRM write is side-effecting


class RehearsalError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass
class OnboardRehearsal:
    run: str
    root: Path  # scratch, outside every repository
    seed: int = 1
    limit: int = 24
    log: Callable[[str], None] = field(default=print)


def _text(path: Path) -> bytes:
    return path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")  # the same digest on any checkout's EOLs


def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(_text(path)).hexdigest()


CACHES = {"__pycache__", ".ruff_cache", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache", ".onboard-verdicts.json"}


def _tree_sha(folder: Path) -> str:
    """The source tree's digest; tool caches other runs leave behind (ruff, pytest) excluded."""
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for path in sorted(p for p in folder.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix != ".pyc"
                       and not CACHES.intersection(p.relative_to(folder).parts)):  # fmt: skip
        digest.update(path.relative_to(folder).as_posix().encode("utf-8") + b"\0")
        digest.update(_text(path))
    return digest.hexdigest()


def prepare_checkout(root: Path) -> Path:
    checkout = root / "checkout"
    shutil.copytree(PRACTICE, checkout, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
    return checkout


def export_traces(checkout: Path, out: Path, *, seed: int, limit: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run the practice host's train tasks behind a local fabric; export their traces."""
    import importlib

    target = load_target(checkout, HOST)
    target.make_importable()
    tasks = importlib.import_module(f"{target.host.package}.evals.generate").tasks("train")[:limit]
    profile = target.stress()
    if profile is None:
        raise RehearsalError(f"{HOST} declares no stress profile")
    config = FabricConfig(seed=seed, profile=profile, live_services=target.live_services)
    argv = [sys.executable, "-m", "kintsugi.onboard.trace_export", "--host", target.host.package,
            "--split", "train", "--seed", str(seed), "--phase", "rehearsal",
            "--out", str(out)]  # fmt: skip
    with Fabric({target.id: target.host}, config) as fabric:
        env = {**fabric.env(target.id), **target.code_env(checkout)}
        result = proc.run(argv, extra_env=env, input_text=tasks_jsonl(tasks), timeout_s=900)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RehearsalError(f"trace export failed: {result.stderr[-2000:]}")
    lines = [json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
    rows = [line for line in lines if "guard" not in line]
    guard = next((line["guard"] for line in lines if "guard" in line), None)
    if guard is None:
        raise RehearsalError("the trace export did not report its socket guard")
    verdicts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in rows:
        verdicts[str(row["verdict"])] = verdicts.get(str(row["verdict"]), 0) + 1
    return {"tasks": len(rows), "verdicts": dict(sorted(verdicts.items())),
            "traces": len([p for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]),
            "profile": target.stress_profile, "seed": seed, "model_mode": "offline",
            "host_non_loopback_refused": guard["non_loopback_refused"],
            "export_sha256": _tree_sha(out)}  # fmt: skip


def run(cfg: OnboardRehearsal) -> dict[str, Any]:
    started = time.monotonic()
    cfg.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with trace_export.LoopbackGuard() as guard:
        checkout = prepare_checkout(cfg.root)
        exports = cfg.root / "exports"

toolUseResult.originalFile:
"""Chaos-proxy delivery of environment sabotage (Appendix B ``env.*``, §7.2, §7.7).

Patch classes are delivered as an upstream change through a notary session; the five
environment classes are delivered here instead, as **overlay rules** for the chaos proxy that
already sits in front of every host's external services:

- ``ChaosOverlay.deliver(spec)`` compiles an opened spec into chaos rules on the target tool's
  external service and writes ``<folder>/<spec id>.json`` atomically, active from now until
  ``schedule.duration_s`` later. The folder lives under the runtime's state directory, outside
  the repository; the fleet's chaos proxy reads it on every call (``ChaosProxy(overlay=…)``).
- Overlay draws are keyed by the sabotage id, never by a rule index, so adding or expiring an
  overlay never shifts the background profile's seeded faults (A-24).

The mapping from catalog parameters to faults:

| class | fault | parameters |
|---|---|---|
| ``env.rate_limit`` | ``status`` 429 | ``rate``; a firing call starts a run of ``burst`` failing calls |
| ``env.latency`` | ``latency`` | log-normal delay through ``p50_ms`` and ``p95_ms`` |
| ``env.schema_drift`` | ``schema_drift`` | ``change``: rename_field, drop_field or type_change |
| ``env.partial_response`` | ``partial`` | keeps ``100 − truncation_pct`` percent of a list or text |
| ``env.pagination_change`` | ``pagination`` | pages of ``page_size`` with a ``cursor_format`` cursor |
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import threading
from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.sandbox.chaos_proxy import Rule

DEFAULT_DURATION_S = 1800.0  # an environment fault lasts 30 minutes unless the spec says so
OVERLAY_DIR = Path("chaos") / "active"  # under the runtime's state directory


class OverlayError(ValueError):
    pass


def compile_env(spec: Mapping[str, Any], external: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, str]]
                ) -> list[Rule]:  # fmt: skip
    """``external``: host → tool → the external service its calls go through."""
    cls = str(spec.get("class", ""))
    target = dict(spec.get("target") or {})
    host, tool = str(target.get("host", "")), str(target.get("tool", ""))
    service = (external.get(host) or {}).get(tool)
    if service is None:
        raise OverlayError(f"{tool!r} is not an external tool of {host!r}")
    sid = str(spec.get("id"))
    tag = {"sabotage": sid}
    if cls == "env.rate_limit":
        return [Rule(service, "status", float(target["rate"]), "*",
                     {**tag, "status": 429, "burst": int(target["burst"])})]  # fmt: skip
    if cls == "env.latency":
        return [Rule(service, "latency", 1.0, "*",
                     {**tag, "p50_ms": int(target["p50_ms"]),
                      "p95_ms": int(target["p95_ms"])})]  # fmt: skip
    if cls == "env.schema_drift":
        return [Rule(service, "schema_drift", 1.0, "*", {**tag, "change": str(target["change"])})]
    if cls == "env.partial_response":
        keep = 1.0 - int(target["truncation_pct"]) / 100.0
        return [Rule(service, "partial", 1.0, "*", {**tag, "keep": keep})]
    if cls == "env.pagination_change":
        return [Rule(service, "pagination", 1.0, "*",
                     {**tag, "page_size": int(target["page_size"]),
                      "cursor_format": str(target["cursor_format"])})]  # fmt: skip
    raise OverlayError(f"{cls} is not an environment class: it is delivered as a patch")


def _rule_json(rule: Rule) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"service": rule.service, "fault": rule.fault, "rate": rule.rate, "path": rule.path,
            "params": dict(rule.params)}  # fmt: skip


def _rule(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Rule:
    return Rule(str(data["service"]), data["fault"], float(data["rate"]), str(data["path"]),
                dict(data.get("params") or {}))  # fmt: skip


class ChaosOverlay:
    """Active environment sabotage, one JSON file per sealed spec, read by the chaos proxy."""

    def __init__(self, folder: Path, external: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, str]] | None = None,
                 ) -> None:  # fmt: skip
        self.folder = Path(folder)
        self.external = {h: dict(t) for h, t in (external or {}).items()}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._cache: tuple[float, list[tuple[str, Rule, datetime, datetime]]] | None = None

    @classmethod
    def for_fleet(cls, state_dir: Path, repo: Path) -> ChaosOverlay:
        from kintsugi.fleet.hosts import load_hosts

        external = {host: {name: tool.external for name, tool in spec.tools.items()
                           if tool.external}
                    for host, spec in load_hosts(repo).items()}  # fmt: skip
        return cls(Path(state_dir) / OVERLAY_DIR, external)

    def deliver(self, spec: Mapping[str, Any], *, now: datetime | None = None) -> str:
        """Activate an opened environment spec; returns the overlay file's path."""
        rules = compile_env(spec, self.external)
        start = now or datetime.now(UTC)
        duration = float((spec.get("schedule") or {}).get("duration_s") or DEFAULT_DURATION_S)
        body = {"sabotage": str(spec["id"]), "class": spec["class"],
                "host": spec["target"]["host"], "start": start.isoformat(),
                "until": (start + timedelta(seconds=duration)).isoformat(),
                "rules": [_rule_json(r) for r in rules]}  # fmt: skip
        self.folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = self.folder / f"{spec['id']}.json"
        temp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        temp.write_text(json.dumps(body, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        os.replace(temp, path)
        with self._lock:
            self._cache = None
        return path.as_posix()

    def _load(self) -> list[tuple[str, Rule, datetime, datetime]]:
        if not self.folder.is_dir():
            return []
        stamp = max((p.stat().st_mtime for p in self.folder.glob("*.json")), default=0.0)
        with self._lock:
            if self._cache is not None and self._cache[0] == stamp:
                return self._cache[1]
        found = []
        for path in sorted(self.folder.glob("*.json")):
            try:
                body = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                start = datetime.fromisoformat(body["start"])
                until = datetime.fromisoformat(body["until"])
                for i, raw in enumerate(body["rules"]):
                    found.append((f"{body['sabotage']}:{i}", _rule(raw), start, until))
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
                continue  # a half-written or foreign file never breaks the proxy
        with self._lock:
            self._cache = (stamp, found)
        return found

    def rules(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> list[tuple[str, Rule]]:
        """The overlay rules active at ``now``, each with its stable draw key."""
        at = now or datetime.now(UTC)
        return [(key, rule) for key, rule, start, until in self._load() if start <= at < until]

    def active(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> list[str]:
        return sorted({key.split(":")[0] for key, _ in self.rules(now)})

"""Onboarding O1–O7 (Stage 10), offline: intake, health card, replay mode, evals, scan, terms."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
import yaml

from kintsugi.memory import graph
from kintsugi.memory.library import AntibodyLibrary
from kintsugi.onboard import eval_synth, immune_scan, instrument, intake, pipeline, replay_mode

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
NEATLOGS = REPO / "tests" / "fixtures" / "neatlogs"
CRM = REPO / "tests" / "fixtures" / "rehearsal" / "crm_practice"
TRACE = "d23ffdad100e3a3bd55365ebc266447d"


def _form(repo: str = "octo-org/support-agent", consents: tuple[str, ...] = intake.CONSENTS,
          entry: str = "agent/main.py") -> str:  # fmt: skip
    boxes = "\n".join(f"- [x] {c}" for c in consents)
    return (f"### Repository\n\n{repo}\n\n### Agent entry point\n\n{entry}\n\n"
            "### What goes wrong\n\nDuplicate tickets after a timeout.\n\n"
            f"### Consent\n\n{boxes}\n")  # fmt: skip


def test_the_issue_form_and_the_parser_agree() -> None:
    form = yaml.safe_load((REPO / ".github" / "ISSUE_TEMPLATE" / "clinic-intake.yml").read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"))  # fmt: skip
    labels = {item["attributes"]["label"] for item in form["body"] if item["type"] != "markdown"}
    assert labels == {"Repository", "Agent entry point", "What goes wrong", "Consent"}
    consent = next(i for i in form["body"] if i.get("id") == "consent")
    assert tuple(o["label"] for o in consent["attributes"]["options"]) == intake.CONSENTS
    assert all(o["required"] for o in consent["attributes"]["options"])


def test_intake_requires_every_consent_and_marks_foreign_repos_pr_only() -> None:
    accepted = intake.parse(_form())
    assert accepted.repo == "octo-org/support-agent"
    assert accepted.foreign
    assert accepted.pr_only
    assert pipeline.ship_config(accepted).pr_only  # O7: Omega never merges there
    assert not intake.parse(_form(repo=intake.OWN[0])).pr_only
    assert intake.parse(_form(repo="https://github.com/octo-org/support-agent/")).repo == (
        "octo-org/support-agent")  # fmt: skip
    with pytest.raises(intake.IntakeRefused, match="consent"):
        intake.parse(_form(consents=intake.CONSENTS[:-1]))
    unchecked = _form().replace("- [x] Fixes arrive", "- [ ] Fixes arrive")
    with pytest.raises(intake.IntakeRefused, match="consent"):
        intake.parse(unchecked)
    for bad in ("octo-org", "octo/org/x", "a b/c", "../etc"):
        with pytest.raises(intake.IntakeRefused, match="owner/name"):
            intake.parse(_form(repo=bad))
    for bad in ("/etc/passwd", "../outside.py", "agent/../../x.py", ""):
        with pytest.raises(intake.IntakeRefused, match="entry point"):
            intake.parse(_form(entry=bad))


def test_the_health_card_reads_a_checkout_statically(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    card = instrument.scan(CRM)
    assert card.python_files > 0
    assert any("retry" in r for r in card.retry_wrappers)
    assert card.tests
    agent = tmp_path / "agent"
    (agent / "pkg").mkdir(parents=True)
    (agent / "pkg" / "main.py").write_text(
        "import anthropic\nimport httpx\n\n"
        "def tool(f):\n    return f\n\n"
        "@tool\ndef create_ticket(x):\n"
        "    return httpx.post('https://example.invalid', json=x)\n\n"
        "def run(c):\n    return c.messages.create(model='m', messages=[])\n",
        encoding="utf-8")  # fmt: skip
    card = instrument.scan(agent)
    assert card.model_imports == ["anthropic"]
    assert card.model_calls == 1
    assert card.tools == ["pkg/main.py:create_ticket"]
    assert card.side_effecting_http == ["pkg/main.py:9 httpx.post"]
    assert not card.neatlogs_init and not card.tests  # noqa: PT018
    assert any("neatlogs" in n for n in card.needs)


@pytest.fixture
def exports(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:

"""The OSS-1 onboarding rehearsal (Stage 10, offline, disclosed): exports, guard, O1–O7, CLI."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import socket
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.trace import Status, StatusCode

from kintsugi.cli import main
from kintsugi.onboard import intake, rehearsal, replay_mode, trace_export

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
EVIDENCE = sorted((REPO / "evidence" / "rehearsals").glob("oss1-*.json"))


def _spans(seed: int = 3) -> list[Any]:
    memory = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = TracerProvider(id_generator=trace_export.seeded_ids(seed))
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(memory))
    tracer = provider.get_tracer("test")
    root_attrs = {"openinference.span.kind": "WORKFLOW", "neatlogs.workflow_name": "host:pkg",
                  "neatlogs.tags": "host:pkg,split:train,seed:3", "input.value": '{"id": "T-1"}',
                  "input.mime_type": "application/json"}  # fmt: skip
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("task:T-1", attributes=root_attrs):
        tool_attrs = {"openinference.span.kind": "TOOL", "input.value": '{"domain": "a.test"}'}
        with tracer.start_as_current_span("enrich", attributes=tool_attrs) as s:
            s.record_exception(RuntimeError("enrich a.test: HTTP 429"))
            s.set_status(Status(StatusCode.ERROR, "HTTP 429"))
        with tracer.start_as_current_span("grader.verdict", attributes={
                "openinference.span.kind": "CHAIN",
                "input.value": '{"task_id": "T-1", "verdict": "FAIL:DUPLICATE_CONTACT"}',
                "input.mime_type": "application/json",
                "output.value": '"FAIL:DUPLICATE_CONTACT"',
                "output.mime_type": "application/json"}):  # fmt: skip
            pass
    return list(memory.get_finished_spans())


def test_captured_spans_export_in_the_public_api_shape_and_replay(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    exports = trace_export.to_exports(_spans())
    assert len(exports) == 1
    trace_id, files = next(iter(exports.items()))
    assert sorted(files) == ["raw_spans.json", "spans.json", "trace.json"]
    summary = files["trace.json"]["body"]["data"]
    assert summary["traceName"] == "task:T-1"
    assert summary["workflowName"] == "host:pkg"
    assert summary["tags"] == ["host:pkg", "split:train", "seed:3"]
    assert summary["toolCallsCount"] == 1 and summary["spansCount"] == 3  # noqa: PT018
    trace_export.write_exports(exports, tmp_path)
    [record] = replay_mode.ExportedTraces(tmp_path).records()  # the live load_trace path
    assert record.trace_id == trace_id
    assert record.task_id == "T-1"
    assert [v.verdict for v in record.verdicts] == ["FAIL:DUPLICATE_CONTACT"]
    tool = next(s for s in record.spans if s.name == "enrich")
    assert tool.failed and "HTTP 429" in (tool.error or "")  # noqa: PT018
    repro = record.repro()  # the tags name the task to re-run, as a live trace's would
    assert repro is not None
    assert (repro.host, repro.task_id, repro.split, repro.seed) == ("pkg", "T-1", "train", 3)


def test_seeded_ids_export_the_same_ids_for_the_same_seed() -> None:
    assert list(trace_export.to_exports(_spans(5))) == list(trace_export.to_exports(_spans(5)))
    assert list(trace_export.to_exports(_spans(5))) != list(trace_export.to_exports(_spans(6)))


def test_previews_are_truncated_and_say_so() -> None:
    long = "x" * (trace_export.PREVIEW_LIMIT + 10)
    preview = trace_export._preview(long, "text/plain")
    assert preview["truncated"] is True
    assert len(preview["preview"]) == trace_export.PREVIEW_LIMIT


def test_the_guard_refuses_non_loopback_connections_and_counts_them() -> None:
    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    server.listen(1)
    with trace_export.LoopbackGuard() as guard:
        client = socket.create_connection(server.getsockname(), timeout=5)  # loopback: allowed
        client.close()
        outside = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        with pytest.raises(trace_export.NonLoopbackRefused):
            outside.connect(("192.0.2.1", 443))  # TEST-NET-1: never reached
        outside.close()
    server.close()
    assert guard.refused == ["('192.0.2.1', 443)"]
    assert socket.socket.connect is not None


def test_the_intake_fixture_has_every_consent_and_is_foreign() -> None:

    assert accepted.consents == intake.CONSENTS
    assert accepted.foreign and accepted.pr_only  # noqa: PT018
    assert accepted.entry_point == "practice_crm/agent.py"
    assert (rehearsal.PRACTICE / accepted.entry_point).is_file()


def test_the_checkout_digest_ignores_tool_caches(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    (tmp_path / "pkg").mkdir()

    for cache in (".ruff_cache", ".pytest_cache", "pkg/__pycache__"):
        (tmp_path / cache).mkdir(parents=True)
        (tmp_path / cache / "junk").write_text("cache", encoding="utf-8")
    assert rehearsal._tree_sha(tmp_path) == before

"""The OSS-1 onboarding rehearsal (Stage 10, offline, disclosed): exports, guard, O1–O7, CLI."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import socket
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.trace import Status, StatusCode

from kintsugi.cli import main
from kintsugi.onboard import intake, rehearsal, replay_mode, trace_export

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
EVIDENCE = sorted((REPO / "evidence" / "rehearsals").glob("oss1-*.json"))


def _spans(seed: int = 3) -> list[Any]:
    memory = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = TracerProvider(id_generator=trace_export.seeded_ids(seed))
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(memory))
    tracer = provider.get_tracer("test")
    root_attrs = {"openinference.span.kind": "WORKFLOW", "neatlogs.workflow_name": "host:pkg",
                  "neatlogs.tags": "host:pkg,split:train,seed:3", "input.value": '{"id": "T-1"}',
                  "input.mime_type": "application/json"}  # fmt: skip
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("task:T-1", attributes=root_attrs):
        tool_attrs = {"openinference.span.kind": "TOOL", "input.value": '{"domain": "a.test"}'}
        with tracer.start_as_current_span("enrich", attributes=tool_attrs) as s:
            s.record_exception(RuntimeError("enrich a.test: HTTP 429"))
            s.set_status(Status(StatusCode.ERROR, "HTTP 429"))
        with tracer.start_as_current_span("grader.verdict", attributes={
                "openinference.span.kind": "CHAIN",
                "input.value": '{"task_id": "T-1", "verdict": "FAIL:DUPLICATE_CONTACT"}',
                "input.mime_type": "application/json",
                "output.value": '"FAIL:DUPLICATE_CONTACT"',
                "output.mime_type": "application/json"}):  # fmt: skip
            pass
    return list(memory.get_finished_spans())


def test_captured_spans_export_in_the_public_api_shape_and_replay(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    exports = trace_export.to_exports(_spans())
    assert len(exports) == 1
    trace_id, files = next(iter(exports.items()))
    assert sorted(files) == ["raw_spans.json", "spans.json", "trace.json"]
    summary = files["trace.json"]["body"]["data"]
    assert summary["traceName"] == "task:T-1"
    assert summary["workflowName"] == "host:pkg"
    assert summary["tags"] == ["host:pkg", "split:train", "seed:3"]
    assert summary["toolCallsCount"] == 1 and summary["spansCount"] == 3  # noqa: PT018
    trace_export.write_exports(exports, tmp_path)
    [record] = replay_mode.ExportedTraces(tmp_path).records()  # the live load_trace path
    assert record.trace_id == trace_id
    assert record.task_id == "T-1"
    assert [v.verdict for v in record.verdicts] == ["FAIL:DUPLICATE_CONTACT"]
    tool = next(s for s in record.spans if s.name == "enrich")
    assert tool.failed and "HTTP 429" in (tool.error or "")  # noqa: PT018
    repro = record.repro()  # the tags name the task to re-run, as a live trace's would
    assert repro is not None
    assert (repro.host, repro.task_id, repro.split, repro.seed) == ("pkg", "T-1", "train", 3)


def test_seeded_ids_export_the_same_ids_for_the_same_seed() -> None:
    assert list(trace_export.to_exports(_spans(5))) == list(trace_export.to_exports(_spans(5)))
    assert list(trace_export.to_exports(_spans(5))) != list(trace_export.to_exports(_spans(6)))


def test_previews_are_truncated_and_say_so() -> None:
    long = "x" * (trace_export.PREVIEW_LIMIT + 10)
    preview = trace_export._preview(long, "text/plain")
    assert preview["truncated"] is True
    assert len(preview["preview"]) == trace_export.PREVIEW_LIMIT


def test_the_guard_refuses_non_loopback_connections_and_counts_them() -> None:
    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    server.listen(1)
    with trace_export.LoopbackGuard() as guard:
        client = socket.create_connection(server.getsockname(), timeout=5)  # loopback: allowed
        client.close()
        outside = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        with pytest.raises(trace_export.NonLoopbackRefused):
            outside.connect(("192.0.2.1", 443))  # TEST-NET-1: never reached
        outside.close()
    server.close()
    assert guard.refused == ["('192.0.2.1', 443)"]
    assert socket.socket.connect is not None


def test_the_intake_fixture_has_every_consent_and_is_foreign() -> None:
    accepted = intake.parse(rehearsal.INTAKE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert accepted.consents == intake.CONSENTS
    assert accepted.foreign and accepted.pr_only  # noqa: PT018
    assert accepted.entry_point == "practice_crm/agent.py"
    assert (rehearsal.PRACTICE / accepted.entry_point).is_file()


def test_the_checkout_digest_ignores_tool_caches(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    (tmp_path / "pkg").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "pkg" / "a.py").write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    before = rehearsal._tree_sha(tmp_path)
    for cache in (".ruff_cache", ".pytest_cache", "pkg/__pycache__"):
        (tmp_path / cache).mkdir(parents=True)
        (tmp_path / cache / "junk").write_text("cache", encoding="utf-8")
    assert rehearsal._tree_sha(tmp_path) == before
    (tmp_path / "pkg" / "a.py").write_text("x = 2\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert rehearsal._tree_sha(tmp_path) != before

def _spans(seed: int = 3) -> list[Any]:
    memory = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = TracerProvider(id_generator=trace_export.seeded_ids(seed))
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(memory))
    tracer = provider.get_tracer("test")
    root_attrs = {"openinference.span.kind": "WORKFLOW", "neatlogs.workflow_name": "host:pkg",
                  "neatlogs.tags": "host:pkg,split:train,seed:3", "input.value": '{"id": "T-1"}',
                  "input.mime_type": "application/json"}  # fmt: skip
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("task:T-1", attributes=root_attrs):
        tool_attrs = {"openinference.span.kind": "TOOL", "input.value": '{"domain": "a.test"}'}
        with tracer.start_as_current_span("enrich", attributes=tool_attrs) as s:
            s.record_exception(RuntimeError("enrich a.test: HTTP 429"))
            s.set_status(Status(StatusCode.ERROR, "HTTP 429"))
        with tracer.start_as_current_span("grader.verdict", attributes={
                "openinference.span.kind": "CHAIN",
                "input.value": '{"task_id": "T-1", "verdict": "FAIL:DUPLICATE_CONTACT"}',
                "input.mime_type": "application/json",

                "output.mime_type": "application/json"}):  # fmt: skip

    return list(memory.get_finished_spans())

    trace_export.write_exports(exports, tmp_path)

def test_the_guard_refuses_non_loopback_connections_and_counts_them() -> None:
    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    server.listen(1)
    with trace_export.LoopbackGuard() as guard:
        client = socket.create_connection(server.getsockname(), timeout=5)  # loopback: allowed
        client.close()
        outside = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        with pytest.raises(trace_export.NonLoopbackRefused):
            outside.connect(("192.0.2.1", 443))  # TEST-NET-1: never reached
        outside.close()
    server.close()
    assert guard.refused == ["('192.0.2.1', 443)"]
    assert socket.socket.connect is not None

"""The Saboteur on a disclosed practice spec: realism rules, the deterministic rubric, sealing
into an age store outside the repository, leak-free delivery, and audit C6 over the result.
No model is called: the rubric is the deterministic fallback.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any
import pytest
from kintsugi.crew.factory import FileLedger, OmegaCrew, SabotageLane
from kintsugi.crew.notary import NotaryRequest
from kintsugi.crew.saboteur import (
    CATALOG,
    SabotageRefused,
    Saboteur,
    compose,
    deterministic_rubric,
    patch_sha256,
    realism_problems,
)
from kintsugi.proof import audit, sealed
from kintsugi.proof.audit import Status
from kintsugi.proof.ledger import genesis_hash
REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FLEET = ("practice",)
PATCH = """--- a/hosts/practice/practice/fetch.py
+++ b/hosts/practice/practice/fetch.py
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@ def fetch_all(client):
     try:
         return client.fetch()
-    except TimeoutError:
-        raise
+    except Exception:
+        return []
"""
NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 12, 6, 0, tzinfo=UTC)  # before any real run of this suite
def _spec(patch: str = PATCH, **overrides: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    spec = compose(
        "S-90", "code.regression.exception_swallow", host="practice",
        framing="Simplify error handling in fetch_all", patch=patch,
        ground_truth={"files": ["hosts/practice/practice/fetch.py"], "symbols": ["fetch_all"],
                      "mechanism": "a broad except returns an empty list on any failure"},
        not_before=(NOW + timedelta(minutes=1)).isoformat(), seed=4242,
    )  # fmt: skip
    spec.update(overrides)
    return spec
@pytest.fixture
def identity() -> tuple[str, str]:
    return sealed.new_identity()
@pytest.fixture
def saboteur(tmp_path_factory: pytest.TempPathFactory, identity: tuple[str, str]) -> Saboteur:
    store = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("sabotage-store")
    return Saboteur(store, (identity[1],), FLEET, clock=lambda: NOW)


def test_crew_steps_seal_deliver_and_satisfy_c6(
    saboteur: Saboteur, identity: tuple[str, str], tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    """The dry run: seal a practice spec, deliver it through a recorded port, reveal it, and
    let audit C6 check commitment, ordering and honeytoken."""
    spec = _spec()
    delivered: list[tuple[NotaryRequest, str]] = []
    published: list[NotaryRequest] = []
    lane = SabotageLane(saboteur, identity[0],
                        deliver=lambda req, host: delivered.append((req, host)) or "pr-1",
                        plans={"S-90": (spec, PATCH)},
                        publish=lambda req: published.append(req) or "sha")  # fmt: skip
    ledger = FileLedger(tmp_path / "ledger.jsonl", genesis_hash("t0", b"\0" * 32))
    crew = SimpleNamespace(ledger=ledger, sabotage=lane, _lane=lambda: lane)

"""The Saboteur on a disclosed practice spec: realism rules, the deterministic rubric, sealing
into an age store outside the repository, leak-free delivery, and audit C6 over the result.
No model is called: the rubric is the deterministic fallback.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

import pytest

from kintsugi.crew.factory import FileLedger, OmegaCrew, SabotageLane
from kintsugi.crew.notary import NotaryRequest
from kintsugi.crew.saboteur import (
    CATALOG,
    SabotageRefused,
    Saboteur,
    compose,
    deterministic_rubric,
    patch_sha256,
    realism_problems,
)
from kintsugi.proof import audit, sealed
from kintsugi.proof.audit import Status
from kintsugi.proof.ledger import genesis_hash

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FLEET = ("practice",)
PATCH = """--- a/hosts/practice/practice/fetch.py
+++ b/hosts/practice/practice/fetch.py
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@ def fetch_all(client):
     try:
         return client.fetch()
-    except TimeoutError:
-        raise
+    except Exception:
+        return []
"""
NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 12, 6, 0, tzinfo=UTC)  # before any real run of this suite


def _spec(patch: str = PATCH, **overrides: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    spec = compose(
        "S-90", "code.regression.exception_swallow", host="practice",
        framing="Simplify error handling in fetch_all", patch=patch,
        ground_truth={"files": ["hosts/practice/practice/fetch.py"], "symbols": ["fetch_all"],
                      "mechanism": "a broad except returns an empty list on any failure"},
        not_before=(NOW + timedelta(minutes=1)).isoformat(), seed=4242,
    )  # fmt: skip
    spec.update(overrides)
    return spec


@pytest.fixture
def identity() -> tuple[str, str]:
    return sealed.new_identity()


@pytest.fixture
def saboteur(tmp_path_factory: pytest.TempPathFactory, identity: tuple[str, str]) -> Saboteur:
    store = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("sabotage-store")
    return Saboteur(store, (identity[1],), FLEET, clock=lambda: NOW)


def test_the_catalog_is_appendix_b() -> None:
    assert len(CATALOG) == 17
    assert "code.regression.state_reset_on_retry" in CATALOG


def test_a_practice_spec_passes_the_rules_and_the_rubric() -> None:
    spec = _spec()
    assert realism_problems(spec, PATCH, fleet=FLEET) == []
    assert deterministic_rubric(spec, PATCH) == 1.0


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("change", "expect"),
    [
        (lambda s, p: ({**s, "class": "code.regression.rm_everything"}, p), "fault catalog"),
        (lambda s, p: ({**s, "target": {"host": "neighbour"}}, p), "blast radius"),
        (
            lambda s, p: (
                s,
                p.replace("hosts/practice/practice/fetch.py", "hosts/practice/tests/test_fetch.py"),
            ),
            "patch_sha256",
        ),
        (lambda s, p: (s, None), "there is none"),
        (
            lambda s, p: (
                {
                    **s,
                    "delivery": {**s["delivery"], "framing": f"Refactor, keep {s['honeytoken']}"},
                },
                p,
            ),
            "honeytoken",
        ),
        (
            lambda s, p: (
                {**s, "delivery": {**s["delivery"], "framing": "Inject the S-90 sabotage"}},
                p,
            ),
            "sabotage id",
        ),
    ],
    ids=["non-catalog", "outside-fleet", "patch-swapped", "no-patch", "leaky-framing", "named"],
)
def test_realism_rejects(change: Any, expect: str) -> None:
    spec, patch = change(_spec(), PATCH)
    problems = realism_problems(spec, patch, fleet=FLEET)
    assert any(expect in p for p in problems), problems


def test_protected_paths_and_destructive_operations_are_refused() -> None:
    to_tests = PATCH.replace("practice/practice/fetch.py", "practice/tests/test_fetch.py")
    problems = realism_problems(_spec(to_tests), to_tests, fleet=FLEET)
    assert any("protected paths" in p for p in problems)
    outside = PATCH.replace("hosts/practice/practice/fetch.py", "kintsugi/proof/audit.py")
    assert any("outside hosts/practice/" in p
               for p in realism_problems(_spec(outside), outside, fleet=FLEET))  # fmt: skip
    wiper = PATCH.replace("+        return []", "+        shutil.rmtree('/data')")
    assert any("destructive" in p for p in realism_problems(_spec(wiper), wiper, fleet=FLEET))


def test_seal_store_open_and_reveal(saboteur: Saboteur, identity: tuple[str, str]) -> None:
    spec = _spec()
    record = saboteur.seal(spec, PATCH)
    assert set(record) == {"id", "c", "sealed_at", "not_before", "class_family"}
    assert record["class_family"] == "code.regression"
    assert saboteur.seal(spec, PATCH) == record  # a retry never re-seals
    stored = b"".join(p.read_bytes() for p in saboteur.store.iterdir())
    assert spec["honeytoken"].encode() not in stored
    assert b"broad except" not in stored
    opened, seal, patch = saboteur.open("S-90", identity[0])
    assert opened == spec
    assert patch == PATCH
    assert sealed.verify_reveal(record["c"], opened, seal.salt)
    path, body = Saboteur.reveal(opened, seal)
    assert path == "sabotage-log/S-90.reveal.json"
    assert b'"salt"' in body


def test_sealing_refuses_a_low_rubric_and_a_store_inside_a_repo(
    saboteur: Saboteur, identity: tuple[str, str]
) -> None:
    elsewhere = compose("S-91", "code.regression.exception_swallow", host="practice",
                        framing="Tidy", patch=PATCH, ground_truth={"files": ["other.py"],
                        "mechanism": "m"}, not_before=NOW.isoformat(), seed=1)  # fmt: skip
    with pytest.raises(SabotageRefused, match="rubric"):
        saboteur.seal(elsewhere, PATCH)
    with pytest.raises(SabotageRefused, match="inside a git worktree"):
        Saboteur(REPO / "sabotage-store", (identity[1],), FLEET)


def test_delivery_carries_the_framing_and_the_patch_only(saboteur: Saboteur) -> None:
    spec = _spec()
    request = Saboteur.delivery_request(spec, PATCH)
    assert request.purpose == ("Simplify error handling in fetch_all. Apply this patch and run "
                               "the existing tests.")  # fmt: skip
    assert request.diff == PATCH
    assert "S-90" not in request.incident + request.subject + request.reference
    leaky = PATCH.replace("return []", f"return []  # {spec['honeytoken']}")
    with pytest.raises(SabotageRefused, match="honeytoken"):
        Saboteur.delivery_request({**spec, "delivery": {**spec["delivery"],
                                   "patch_sha256": patch_sha256(leaky)}}, leaky)  # fmt: skip


def test_the_commitment_request_publishes_only_the_record(saboteur: Saboteur) -> None:
    record = saboteur.seal(_spec(), PATCH)
    request = Saboteur.commitment_request(record)
    assert "+++ b/sabotage-log/S-90.json" in request.diff
    assert record["c"] in request.diff
    assert "honeytoken" not in request.diff


def test_crew_steps_seal_deliver_and_satisfy_c6(
    saboteur: Saboteur, identity: tuple[str, str], tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    """The dry run: seal a practice spec, deliver it through a recorded port, reveal it, and
    let audit C6 check commitment, ordering and honeytoken."""
    spec = _spec()
    delivered: list[tuple[NotaryRequest, str]] = []
    published: list[NotaryRequest] = []
    lane = SabotageLane(saboteur, identity[0],
                        deliver=lambda req, host: delivered.append((req, host)) or "pr-1",
                        plans={"S-90": (spec, PATCH)},
                        publish=lambda req: published.append(req) or "sha")  # fmt: skip
    ledger = FileLedger(tmp_path / "ledger.jsonl", genesis_hash("t0", b"\0" * 32))
    crew = SimpleNamespace(ledger=ledger, sabotage=lane, _lane=lambda: lane)
    step: Any = None
    c = OmegaCrew.do_seal_sabotage(crew, step, "S-90")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    assert OmegaCrew.do_seal_sabotage(crew, step, "S-90") == c  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    assert len(published) == 1
    OmegaCrew.do_deliver_sabotage(crew, step, "S-90")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    assert delivered[0][1] == "practice"
    entries = list(ledger.entries())
    assert [e["event"] for e in entries] == ["sealed", "delivered"]
    _spec_back, seal, _patch = saboteur.open("S-90", identity[0])
    reveal = sealed.reveal_record(spec, seal)
    result = audit.c6_sabotage([saboteur.record("S-90") or {}], {"S-90": reveal}, entries,
                               lambda token: [], window_closed=True)  # fmt: skip
    assert result.status is Status.PASS, result.problems

    memory = InMemorySpanExporter()

    with tracer.start_as_current_span("task:T-9", attributes={

rename/drop/retype, partial_response -> truncation, pagination_change -> a first page with a new
cursor) and writes <state>/chaos/active/<id>.json for its duration; the chaos proxy reads it

seeded faults never move, and logs the sabotage id. The fleet runtime and FabricConfig pass the

reference, delivers once, and raises the new non-retryable DeliveryRefused when no port fits.

    def allocate(self, taken: Callable[[str], bool] = lambda spec_id: False) -> str:
        """The next Arena spec id, never one already allocated here or already sealed in the
        store (``taken``): a reset of this database cannot reuse a sealed id, because sealing an
        existing id returns its earlier commitment (``Saboteur.seal`` is idempotent per id)."""
        with self._lock, self._db() as db:

            while taken(spec_id(n)):

            db.execute("INSERT INTO allocated VALUES (?, ?)", (spec_id(n), n))
            return spec_id(n)
